description: This Java class 'DynamicViewEntity' defines a model for declaring dynamic view entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for constructing XML representations of view entities, managing entity aliases, view links, relations, and other metadata used for dynamic database views.

classes.name: DynamicViewEntity
classes.description: Represents a dynamic view entity in OFBiz, allowing for flexible, on-the-fly creation of entity views with customizable aliases, links, and relations.

methods.name: makeModelViewEntity
methods.description: Creates a ModelViewEntity object based on this dynamic view entity and a given delegator.

methods.name: getViewXml
methods.description: Generates an XML string representation of the view entity for a specified entity name.

methods.name: getViewElement
methods.description: Constructs an XML element representing the view entity, including members, aliases, links, and relations.

methods.name: getOneRealEntityName
methods.description: Returns the entity name of the first member entity, if any.

methods.name: addMemberEntity
methods.description: Adds a member entity alias and name to the view.

methods.name: addAliasAll
methods.description: Adds an alias-all configuration for a specific entity alias with optional prefix and excludes.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias with detailed parameters including field, colAlias, primary key, group by, and function.

methods.name: addViewLink
methods.description: Defines a view link (join) between entities with optional relation details.

methods.name: addRelation
methods.description: Adds a relationship between entities with specified type, title, and key mappings.

methods.name: setGroupBy
methods.description: Sets the list of fields to group by in the view.
